snippet.title: Planet of Lana II | Indie Fan Fest | Feb 2026
snippet.description: Planet of Lana II is a cinematic puzzle-adventure built around companionship and trust. Guide an older, more agile Lana and her loyal companion Mui as their bond becomes the key to moving forward in a world where beauty and danger exist side by side.
